question: Can a dynamically written historical record detect unflagged disagreement and enable repeated repair by a fixed Hamiltonian with finite internal resources?
design_disclosure: Physical model, exact reduction, conservative bounds and predicted negative controls were chosen analytically before numerical production. Code and numerical outputs follow this design freeze.

repeated.ordered_sequences_at_each_sample: All 3^4 length-four sequences, including consecutive reuse of a chain or replica.
repeated.numerical_scope: Exact ready-sector XX dynamics with true fault maps. The writer remains in the physical system and is controlled by the uniform analytical error bound. No intermediate reads or bath resets.

controls.undamaged: Vacuum baths, no replica flips. Zero repair-chain activity and zero historical color change; finite writer reversion is reported.
controls.single_faults: Each individual site flip after nominal writing. Distinct parity masks and work, score repair and both memories.
controls.simultaneous: All three pairs and all three sites at once after nominal writing, terminal wait 136. Predict zero joint historical restoration for each. A pair leaves a discrepancy but wrong majority. All three produce an undetected alternate codeword.
controls.identical_present_state: After nominal writing, history 0 with X_S and history 1 with X_M1 X_M2 land in the same full physical state, with the same ready writer and vacuum reservoirs.
controls.short_reservoir: With L1=L2=1, one M1 fault follows a three-state path with couplings g and kappa. Recurrence at duration 2*pi/sqrt(g^2+kappa^2). A bath excitation at the same interface can create a discrepancy in an otherwise intact triple.
controls.scaling: Verify the general discrimination and storage bounds and evaluate d in {2,3,4,8,16,64}. Distinguish the three-replica single-fault guarantee from two-fault ambiguity.

verification.physical_oracle: Separate AI builds small full physical tensor Hamiltonians including writer and actual pulses, verifies encoding, symmetry, exact acquisition, state collision, repeated-pulse reduction and recurrence. Small reservoir sizes with L1,L2 in {1,2}, plus scaled checks where tractable.
verification.large_solver: Finite Gram matrices of endpoint fermion modes, exact Fock evaluation in their span for the ready comparator with actual physical X maps. Compare to small dense physical dynamics and report the residual writer error explicitly.
verification.proof: Uniform rational probabilities for the actual writer-on Hamiltonian, independent of numerical sampling.

scope: Standard quantum mechanics for classical historical configurations. The fault tests use label-blind timed unitaries. The recognition and correction interactions have no fault flag or historical reference input. They are a supplied majority rule, applied only to the declared correctable class. Autonomous pulse generation, an internal clock and a novel law are separate verdicts.
